question.worked_solution:
First, we find the cumulative probability using symmetry:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(-3<X<3) & =0.7888 \\ 2P(0<X<3) & =0.7888 \\ P(0<X<3) & =0.3944 \\ P(X<3)-P(X<0) & =0.3944 \\ P(X<3)-0.5 & =0.3944 \\ P(X<3) & =0.8944 \\ P(X\le 3) & =0.8944\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we transform to a standard normal random variable by $z$-scoring:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\le 3) & =0.8944 \\ P\,(Z\le \frac{3-0}{\sigma }) & =0.8944 \\ Φ\,(\frac{3}{\sigma }) & =0.8944 \\ \frac{3}{\sigma } & ={Φ}^{-1}(0.8944)\end{aligned}
$$

According to the table, we have

$$
Φ(1.25)=0.8944\,⇒\,{Φ}^{-1}(0.8944)=1.25.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{3}{\sigma } & =1.25 \\ \sigma  & =\frac{3}{1.25} \\ \sigma  & =2.4.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally,

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sigma }^{2} & =(2.4)^{2}=5.76.\end{aligned}
$$
